en: The Sultanate of Bidar as an early modern Indian polity ruled by the Barid Shahi dynasty in the central Deccan
Its place as one of the five Deccan sultanates, its initial territory corresponding to one of the five provinces of the Bahmani kingdom
zh: 比德尔苏丹国是印度早期近代政体，由巴里德沙希王朝统治德干中部
是德干五个苏丹国之一，最初领土相当于巴赫曼尼王国五省之一

politics.zh: 比德尔苏丹国是印度早期近代政体，由巴里德沙希王朝统治德干中部，以比德尔为中心，是德干五个苏丹国之一，最初领土相当于巴赫曼尼王国五省之一。它由原巴赫曼尼王朝的大臣家族建立，16世纪与艾哈迈德讷格尔、比贾普尔等苏丹国结盟对抗维查耶纳伽尔，1565年塔利科塔战役后势力增强，1619年被比贾普尔吞并。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Bidar was an early modern Indian polity ruled by the Barid Shahi dynasty over territory in the central Deccan centred at Bidar, and it was one of the five Deccan sultanates, its initial territory corresponding to one of the five provinces of the Bahmani kingdom. Established by a family of former Bahmani ministers, it allied with Ahmadnagar and Bijapur against Vijayanagara in the sixteenth century, grew stronger after the battle of Talikota in 1565 and was annexed by Bijapur in 1619.

economy.zh: 经济以德干高原的农业、手工业与跨区域贸易为基础，比德尔是市场与兵器制造中心，比达里金属镶嵌工艺闻名，马匹与布匹经内陆商路流通。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming on the Deccan plateau, crafts and interregional trade, with Bidar a market and centre of arms manufacture famous for its bidri metal inlay work, and horses and cloth moving along inland routes.

culture.zh: 比德尔苏丹国继承巴赫曼尼的文化传统，波斯语与乌尔都语用于宫廷与文书，苏菲道堂与经学院活跃，建筑与细密画融合波斯与德干风格。
culture.en: The Bidar Sultanate inherited the cultural tradition of the Bahmanis: Persian and Urdu served the court and documents, Sufi lodges and colleges were active, and its architecture and miniature painting combined Persian and Deccani styles.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪末巴里德家族掌权、16世纪与德干诸国的联盟、1565年塔利科塔战役，以及1619年被比贾普尔吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the rise of the Barid family to power at the end of the fifteenth century, the alliances with the other Deccan states in the sixteenth, the battle of Talikota in 1565 and its annexation by Bijapur in 1619.

value.zh: 以比德尔为中心，是德干五苏丹国之一。
value.en: It was centred at Bidar and was one of the five Deccan sultanates.

en: The Chauhan dynasty as a dynasty associated with various ruling Rajput families in present-day Rajasthan from the seventh century onwards
Its most important branches at Shakambhari, modern Sambhar, and at Ajmer
zh: 兆汉王朝是与今拉贾斯坦多个拉吉普特统治家族相关的王朝，7世纪起见于记载
以沙迦姆巴里（今桑巴尔）与阿杰梅尔的分支最为重要

politics.zh: 兆汉王朝是与今拉贾斯坦多个拉吉普特统治家族相关的王朝，7世纪起见于记载，其中以沙迦姆巴里（今桑巴尔）与阿杰梅尔的分支最为重要。它长期与伽色尼王朝及古尔王朝交战，普里特维拉吉·兆汉在12世纪抵抗穆罕默德·古尔，1192年塔拉因战役失败后其地在德里苏丹国扩张中被并入。
politics.en: The Chauhan dynasty is associated with various ruling Rajput families in present-day Rajasthan from the seventh century onwards, the branches at Shakambhari, modern Sambhar, and at Ajmer being the most important. It fought for generations with the Ghaznavids and the Ghurids, and Prithviraj Chauhan resisted Muhammad of Ghor in the twelfth century; after defeat at the battle of Tarain in 1192 its lands were absorbed during the expansion of the Delhi Sultanate.

economy.zh: 经济以拉贾斯坦的农业、畜牧与跨沙漠商路为基础，阿杰梅尔处在通往古吉拉特与信德的通道上，城镇从贸易与关税中获益，盐与布匹是重要商品。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, herding and the routes crossing the Rajasthan desert, with Ajmer on the road towards Gujarat and Sindh, its towns benefiting from trade and tolls, and salt and cloth as important goods.

culture.zh: 兆汉家族赞助印度教寺庙与梵语文学，阿杰梅尔的阿纳萨加尔湖与寺庙建筑留下遗产，其宫廷诗人与编年史诗塑造了拉吉普特武士传统，普里特维拉吉的事迹广为流传。
culture.en: The Chauhans patronised Hindu temples and Sanskrit literature, the Anasagar lake and temple buildings at Ajmer leaving a heritage, and their court poets and chronicles shaping the Rajput warrior tradition, with the deeds of Prithviraj widely remembered.

events.zh: 关键节点包括7世纪起见于记载、11至12世纪与伽色尼及古尔王朝的战争、1192年塔拉因战役，以及此后其地并入德里苏丹国。
events.en: Key moments are its appearance in records from the seventh century, the wars with the Ghaznavids and Ghurids in the eleventh and twelfth, the battle of Tarain in 1192 and the absorption of its lands into the Delhi Sultanate afterwards.

value.zh: 以沙迦姆巴里与阿杰梅尔的分支最为重要。
value.en: Its branches at Shakambhari and Ajmer were the most important.

value.zh: 1192年塔拉因战役失败后其地并入德里苏丹国。
value.en: After defeat at Tarain in 1192 its lands passed to the Delhi Sultanate.

en: The Madurai Nayaks as a Telugu-speaking dynasty of Balija origin ruling large parts of modern Tamil Nadu between the sixteenth and eighteenth centuries
Its capital at Madurai and its foundation by Viswanatha Nayak, son of Nagama Nayak
zh: 马杜赖纳亚克王朝是讲泰卢固语、出自巴利贾武士族群的王朝，16至18世纪统治今泰米尔纳德大部
以马杜赖为都，由纳加马·纳亚克之子维斯瓦纳塔·纳亚克建立

politics.zh: 马杜赖纳亚克王朝是讲泰卢固语、出自巴利贾武士族群的王朝，16至18世纪统治今泰米尔纳德大部，以马杜赖为都，由纳加马·纳亚克之子维斯瓦纳塔·纳亚克建立。它最初是维查耶纳伽尔帝国的总督政权，帝国衰落后逐渐独立，与坦贾武尔、金吉等纳亚克政权及迈索尔、马拉塔势力交战，18世纪中期被阿尔科特的纳瓦布并入其领地。
politics.en: The Madurai Nayaks were a Telugu-speaking dynasty of Balija origin that ruled large parts of modern Tamil Nadu between the sixteenth and eighteenth centuries, with Madurai as their capital, and they were founded by Viswanatha Nayak, son of Nagama Nayak. They began as governors for the Vijayanagara empire and became effectively independent as it declined, fighting the Nayak states of Thanjavur and Gingee as well as Mysore and the Marathas, until the Nawab of Arcot absorbed their territory in the mid-eighteenth century.

economy.zh: 经济以卡韦里河三角洲的灌溉稻作、纺织业与寺庙经济为基础，马杜赖与后来的蒂鲁吉拉帕利是商业中心，棉布出口经海路运往东南亚与欧洲。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated rice farming in the Kaveri delta, textiles and the temple economy, with Madurai and later Tiruchirappalli as commercial centres, and cotton cloth exported by sea to South-East Asia and Europe.

culture.zh: 纳亚克时期泰米尔文学与寺庙建筑繁荣，马杜赖的米纳克希神庙建筑群在其统治下大规模扩建，绘画与雕塑形成独特风格，泰卢固与泰米尔文化交融。
culture.en: Under the Nayaks Tamil literature and temple architecture flourished, the Meenakshi temple complex at Madurai was greatly expanded, painting and sculpture developed a distinctive style, and Telugu and Tamil cultures intermingled. Its palace and temple walls still carry the dynasty's murals.

events.zh: 关键节点包括16世纪维斯瓦纳塔·纳亚克受封、17世纪与坦贾武尔等政权的战争、18世纪初的内部分裂，以及18世纪中期被阿尔科特的纳瓦布并入。
events.en: Key moments are the appointment of Viswanatha Nayak in the sixteenth century, the wars with Thanjavur and other powers in the seventeenth, internal division in the early eighteenth and annexation by the Nawab of Arcot in the mid-eighteenth.

value.zh: 最初是维查耶纳伽尔帝国的总督政权。
value.en: It began as a governorship under the Vijayanagara empire.

en: The Sur Empire as an empire ruled by the Afghan-origin Sur dynasty in northern India for about sixteen years between 1538/1540 and 1556
Its capital at Sasaram in modern Bihar and its foundation by Sher Shah Suri
Its control of nearly all of northern India
zh: 苏尔帝国是阿富汗出身的苏尔王朝在北印度建立的帝国，1538/1540至1556年间存在约十六年
以今比哈尔的萨萨拉姆为都，由舍尔沙·苏里建立
一度控制北印度几乎全部地区

politics.zh: 苏尔帝国是阿富汗出身的苏尔王朝在北印度建立的帝国，1538/1540至1556年间存在约十六年，以今比哈尔的萨萨拉姆为都，由舍尔沙·苏里建立，一度控制北印度几乎全部地区。它击败莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍并迫其流亡波斯，重建了北印度的行政与税制；舍尔沙死后帝国分裂，1556年莫卧儿在帕尼帕特战役中重夺德里与阿格拉。
politics.en: The Sur Empire was an empire ruled by the Afghan-origin Sur dynasty in northern India for nearly sixteen or eighteen years between 1538/1540 and 1556, with Sasaram in modern Bihar as its capital. Founded by Sher Shah Suri, it held control of nearly all of northern India, defeated the Mughal emperor Humayun and drove him into Persian exile, and rebuilt the administration and revenue system of the north; after Sher Shah's death the empire split and in 1556 the Mughals recovered Delhi and Agra at the second battle of Panipat.

economy.zh: 经济以恒河平原的农业与关税收入为基础，舍尔沙改革税制、以土地丈量为征税依据，并统一货币；大干道经整修成为横贯北印度的商路，驿站与市场随之发展。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Gangetic plain and on customs revenue, with Sher Shah reforming taxation on the basis of land measurement and standardising the coinage; the Grand Trunk Road was repaired as a route across northern India, and post stations and markets grew along it.

culture.zh: 苏尔王朝延续并改造北印度的伊斯兰建筑传统，舍尔沙的陵墓是印度-伊斯兰建筑的杰作，波斯语用于行政，道路、驿站与清真寺的建设留下持久影响。
culture.en: The Sur dynasty continued and transformed the Islamic architectural tradition of northern India, the tomb of Sher Shah being a masterpiece of Indo-Islamic building, Persian serving administration, and its roads, rest houses and mosques leaving a lasting mark.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1539至1540年击败胡马雍、1540至1545年舍尔沙的改革与扩张、1545年舍尔沙战死，以及1556年莫卧儿重夺北印度。
events.en: Key moments are the defeat of Humayun in 1539-1540, the reforms and expansion of Sher Shah from 1540 to 1545, his death in battle in 1545 and the Mughal recovery of northern India in 1556.

value.zh: 由舍尔沙·苏里建立，以萨萨拉姆为都。
value.en: It was founded by Sher Shah Suri with Sasaram as its capital.

value.zh: 改革税制、以土地丈量为征税依据并统一货币。
value.en: It reformed taxation on the basis of land measurement and standardised the coinage.
